_doc: 第 12 幕每格背景描述，Claude 看地圖手寫，2026-11-13

EP1-12-01.zh: 鏡頭從高空往下看，對著空地另一頭的大河。一片長長的森林空地在畫面中間，左右兩邊被茂密的樹林夾住，樹林有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。空地上偏右有一大片高高的蕨類叢。空地盡頭是一條又寬又慢的大河，河的對岸是一條平平的泥岸，再過去是開闊、朦朧的森林，一路延伸到遠方。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，樹影拉得很長，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-01.en: Background: The camera looks down from high in the sky, facing toward a big river beyond the far end of a clearing. A long forest clearing runs up the middle of the picture, hemmed in on the left and right by dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. Right of the middle of the clearing is a large patch of tall ferns. At the far end of the clearing flows a wide, slow river; on its far bank is a strip of flat muddy riverside ground, and beyond that a distant, open, hazy forest stretches away. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, the tree shadows are long, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-01.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-12-02.zh: 鏡頭很低，對著空地另一頭的大河。畫面左邊是一排茂密的樹林，一路往遠處延伸。地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物。空地往前延伸到遠處，盡頭隱約露出一條寬闊的河和對岸朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊的樹林後面低低地照過來，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-02.en: Background: The camera is low, facing up the clearing toward the river at its far end. On the left side of the picture, a row of dense forest runs away into the distance. The ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants. The clearing stretches far ahead, and at its end a wide river and a hazy forest on the far bank can just be seen. The low dusk sun shines from behind the trees on the left side of the picture, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-02.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-12-02W.zh: 鏡頭對著空地另一頭的大河。畫面左邊是一排茂密的樹林，一路往遠處延伸。地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物。畫面右邊遠一點露出一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢的邊緣。空地盡頭是一條寬闊的河，對岸是開闊、朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-02W.en: Background: The camera faces up the clearing toward the river at its far end. On the left side of the picture, a row of dense forest runs away into the distance. The ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants. Farther away on the right side is the edge of a large patch of waist-high ferns. At the end of the clearing is a wide river, and on its far bank a distant, open, hazy forest. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-02W.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-12-03.zh: 鏡頭對著空地另一頭的大河。畫面右邊遠一點是一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢。地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物。空地左右兩邊被茂密的樹林夾住，一路延伸到遠處；空地盡頭是一條寬闊的河，對岸是一條平平的泥岸和開闊、朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-03.en: Background: The camera faces up the clearing toward the river at its far end. Farther away on the right side of the picture is a large patch of waist-high ferns. The ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants. The clearing is hemmed in on the left and right by dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers that runs away into the distance; at the end of the clearing is a wide river, and on its far bank a strip of flat muddy ground and a distant, open, hazy forest. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-03.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-12-03W.zh: 鏡頭在稍高的地方，對著空地另一頭的大河，看得到整片空地。畫面右半邊遠一點是一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢。地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物。空地左右兩邊被茂密的樹林夾住，一路延伸到遠處；空地盡頭是一條又寬又慢的河，對岸是一條平平的泥岸，再過去是開闊、朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，樹影拉得很長，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-03W.en: Background: The camera is a little above the ground, facing up the whole clearing toward the river at its far end. Farther away in the right half of the picture is a large patch of waist-high ferns. The ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants. The clearing is hemmed in on the left and right by dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers that runs away into the distance; at the end of the clearing flows a wide, slow river, with a strip of flat muddy ground on its far bank and a distant, open, hazy forest beyond. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, the tree shadows are long, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-03W.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-12-04.zh: 鏡頭在空地邊的樹林邊緣，很近地對著空地。這是很近的特寫，畫面邊緣只模糊地露出一點空地的地面。黃昏的陽光從鏡頭後面照過來。
EP1-12-04.en: Background: The camera is at the edge of the forest, very close, facing into the clearing. This is a very close shot; only a little blurry forest floor shows at the edges of the picture. Dusk sunlight comes from behind the camera.

EP1-12-05.zh: 鏡頭斜斜地對著空地另一頭的大河。畫面右邊是一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢。地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物。畫面左邊是茂密的樹林，右邊遠處也是樹林，兩排樹林一路延伸到遠處；空地盡頭是一條寬闊的河，對岸是開闊、朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-05.en: Background: The camera faces diagonally up the clearing toward the river at its far end. On the right side of the picture is a large patch of waist-high ferns. The ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants. The left side of the picture is dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, and there is more forest far off on the right; both tree lines run away into the distance. At the end of the clearing is a wide river, and on its far bank a distant, open, hazy forest. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-05.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-12-06.zh: 鏡頭在空地邊的樹林邊緣，斜斜地對著空地另一頭的樹林。遠一點的地方是一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢，再過去是一整排茂密的樹林。黃昏的陽光從鏡頭左後方照過來，把蕨類叢和樹梢照成橘色。
EP1-12-06.en: Background: The camera is at the edge of the forest, facing diagonally across the clearing toward the trees on the other side. A bit farther away is a large patch of waist-high ferns, and beyond it a dense wall of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. Dusk sunlight comes from behind the camera on the left, turning the ferns and treetops orange.
EP1-12-06.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-12-06W.zh: 鏡頭在空地邊的樹林邊緣，斜斜地對著空地另一頭的樹林。地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物。遠一點的地方是一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢，再過去是一整排茂密的樹林。黃昏的陽光從鏡頭左後方照過來，把蕨類叢和樹梢照成橘色。
EP1-12-06W.en: Background: The camera is at the edge of the forest, facing diagonally across the clearing toward the trees on the other side. The ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants. A bit farther away is a large patch of waist-high ferns, and beyond it a dense wall of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. Dusk sunlight comes from behind the camera on the left, turning the ferns and treetops orange.
EP1-12-06W.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-12-07.zh: 從斜上方往下拍地面。畫面裡只有一小塊濕濕的淺泥地，泥巴很薄，邊上散著幾片落葉。黃昏的陽光從畫面左邊斜斜照在泥地上，帶一點橘色。
EP1-12-07.en: Background: Seen from above at a slant, looking down at the ground. Only a small patch of wet, shallow mud is in the picture, just a thin layer of mud with a few fallen leaves scattered at its edge. Orange dusk sunlight slants across the mud from the left side of the picture.

EP1-12-08.zh: 鏡頭對著空地另一頭的大河。畫面中間的地上有一小塊淺淺的泥地。畫面左邊邊緣、不遠處有一顆長滿青苔的大石頭。畫面右邊遠一點是一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢。空地兩邊是茂密的樹林；空地盡頭是一條寬闊的河，對岸是開闊、朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-08.en: Background: The camera faces up the clearing toward the river at its far end. In the middle of the picture is a small patch of shallow mud on the forest floor (only a thin layer of mud, not a pit). At the left edge of the picture, not far away, is a big moss-covered boulder. Farther away on the right side is a large patch of waist-high ferns. Both sides of the clearing are dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers; at the end of the clearing is a wide river, and on its far bank a distant, open, hazy forest. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-08.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。地圖上甲龍（D27–F28）在畫面左邊邊緣看得到，但 prompt 寫只有 HERO 一個角色。照地圖寫成一顆長滿青苔的大石頭（甲龍睡著時的樣子）。

EP1-12-09.zh: 鏡頭對著空地邊的樹林。不遠處就是一整排茂密的樹林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物。黃昏的夕陽在畫面左前方的樹林後面，有一點逆光，樹梢邊緣發亮。
EP1-12-09.en: Background: The camera faces the edge of the forest beside the clearing. A short way off stands a dense wall of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, and the ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants. The low dusk sun is behind the trees ahead on the left side of the picture, slightly backlit, and the treetops glow at the edges.
EP1-12-09.conflict: 已解決（2026-11-13）：照地圖把 prompt 改成 HERO 在左、甲龍在右。原本：照地圖，相機 G30 往 HERO（E29）看時，甲龍（D27–F28）在 HERO 的畫面右邊；composition 和 prompt 寫甲龍的頭在畫面左邊、HERO 在右邊，左右相反。背景照地圖寫，角色左右請確認。

EP1-12-09W.zh: 鏡頭斜斜地對著空地邊的樹林。地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物，往前不遠就是一整排茂密的樹林，一路往畫面右邊遠處延伸。黃昏的夕陽在畫面左前方的樹林後面，有一點逆光。
EP1-12-09W.en: Background: The camera faces diagonally toward the edge of the forest beside the clearing. The ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants, and a short way ahead stands a dense wall of cycads, ginkgos and conifers that runs off into the distance toward the right side of the picture. The low dusk sun is behind the trees ahead on the left side of the picture, slightly backlit.
EP1-12-09W.conflict: 已解決（2026-11-13）：照地圖把 prompt 改成 HERO 在左、甲龍在右。原本：照地圖，相機 G31 往 HERO（E29）看時，甲龍（D27–F28）在 HERO 的畫面右邊；composition 和 prompt 寫甲龍在畫面左邊、HERO 在右邊，左右相反。背景照地圖寫，角色左右請確認。

EP1-12-10.zh: 鏡頭對著空地另一頭。這是很近的特寫，畫面邊緣只模糊地露出一點空地和遠處的樹林。黃昏的陽光從畫面左邊照過來。
EP1-12-10.en: Background: The camera faces up the clearing. This is a very close shot; only a little blurry clearing and distant trees show at the edges of the picture. Dusk sunlight comes from the left side of the picture.

EP1-12-11.zh: 鏡頭對著空地另一頭的大河。畫面下半部、不遠處露出一顆長滿青苔的大石頭的上半部；石頭上方露出空地另一頭遠處的樹林和橘紅色的天空。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左前方低低地照過來。
EP1-12-11.en: Background: The camera faces up the clearing toward the river at its far end. In the lower half of the picture, not far away, the top of a big moss-covered boulder shows; above the boulder are the distant trees at the far end of the clearing and the orange-red sky. The low dusk sun shines from ahead on the left side of the picture.
EP1-12-11.conflict: 地圖上甲龍（D27–F28）正好在畫面中間看得到，但 prompt 寫只有 HERO 一個角色。照地圖寫成一顆長滿青苔的大石頭。

EP1-12-12.zh: 鏡頭貼著地面，斜斜地往上拍。畫面中間不遠處有一顆長滿青苔的大石頭。再過去是一整排高大茂密的樹林；因為鏡頭很低往上看，畫面上半部是樹梢和橘紅色的黃昏天空。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左前方的樹林後面低低地照過來。
EP1-12-12.en: Background: The camera is down on the ground, looking up at a slant. In the middle of the picture, not far away, is a big moss-covered boulder. Beyond it stands a tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers; because the camera is so low and looking up, the upper part of the picture is treetops and the orange-red dusk sky. The low dusk sun shines from behind the trees ahead on the left side of the picture.
EP1-12-12.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。地圖上甲龍（D27–F28）在畫面中間看得到，但 prompt 寫只有 HERO 一個角色。照地圖寫成一顆長滿青苔的大石頭。

EP1-12-13.zh: 鏡頭對著空地另一頭的大河。畫面中間的地上有一小塊淺淺的泥地。畫面左邊、不遠處有一顆長滿青苔的大石頭。畫面右邊遠一點是一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢。空地兩邊是茂密的樹林；空地盡頭是一條寬闊的河，對岸是開闊、朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-13.en: Background: The camera faces up the clearing toward the river at its far end. In the middle of the picture is a small patch of shallow mud on the forest floor (only a thin layer of mud, not a pit). On the left side of the picture, not far away, is a big moss-covered boulder. Farther away on the right side is a large patch of waist-high ferns. Both sides of the clearing are dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers; at the end of the clearing is a wide river, and on its far bank a distant, open, hazy forest. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-13.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。地圖上甲龍（D27–F28）在畫面左邊看得到，但 prompt 寫只有 HERO 一個角色。照地圖寫成一顆長滿青苔的大石頭。

EP1-12-14.zh: 鏡頭斜斜地對著空地另一頭的大河。畫面中間、不遠處的地上是一小塊淺淺的泥地；泥地左邊再過去一點，有一顆長滿青苔的大石頭。畫面右邊邊緣露出一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢。畫面左邊是茂密的樹林，一路延伸到遠處；空地盡頭是一條寬闊的河，對岸是開闊、朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-14.en: Background: The camera faces diagonally up the clearing toward the river at its far end. In the middle of the picture, not far away, is a small patch of shallow mud on the forest floor (only a thin layer of mud, not a pit); a little beyond it to the left is a big moss-covered boulder. At the right edge of the picture shows a large patch of waist-high ferns. The left side of the picture is dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers running away into the distance; at the end of the clearing is a wide river, and on its far bank a distant, open, hazy forest. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-14.conflict: 地圖上甲龍（D27–F28）在畫面中間偏左看得到，但 prompt 寫只有 HERO 一個角色。照地圖寫成一顆長滿青苔的大石頭。

EP1-12-15.zh: 鏡頭在稍高的地方斜斜往下看，對著空地另一頭的大河。地上鋪著落葉和矮矮的植物。畫面右邊邊緣遠一點露出一大片高到人腰的蕨類叢。畫面左邊是一排茂密的樹林，一路往遠處延伸；空地盡頭是一條寬闊的河，對岸是開闊、朦朧的森林。黃昏的夕陽從畫面左邊低低地照過來，樹影拉得很長，天空是橘紅色的。
EP1-12-15.en: Background: The camera is a little above the ground, looking down at a slant and facing up the clearing toward the river at its far end. The ground is covered with leaf litter and low plants. Farther away at the right edge shows a large patch of waist-high ferns. On the left side of the picture, a row of dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers runs away into the distance; at the end of the clearing is a wide river, and on its far bank a distant, open, hazy forest. The low dusk sun shines from the left side of the picture, the tree shadows are long, and the sky is orange-red.
EP1-12-15.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。
